Operational_question: Which distinct development and evaluation scheme did the study implement?
YES_threshold: Published methods, supplementary methods, or verified code identifies the validation/splitting scheme and the role of development and evaluation partitions. Record the design subtype separately (chronological holdout; walk-forward; rolling; expanding; blocked; randomized; mixed; other). A split percentage alone may classify a holdout but cannot establish chronological order.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Explicit admission that no separated evaluation design was used.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: Never for an empirical forecasting evaluation.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: YES means the design was identifiable, not that it was leakage-free. TV02 addresses temporal ordering; TV03 addresses untouched testing; additional design subtype is mandatory for YES.

Operational_question: Were model development and evaluation separated chronologically?
YES_threshold: Time-ordered train/test endpoints, dated split, or explicit out-of-time protocol with nonfuture training.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Statement or code showing randomized time-index train/test assignment or future observations trained before past evaluation.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Do not equate train/test 80/20 with chronological; resolve separately from TV01 and TV03. v1.2: abstract-only 80/20 split with no temporal evidence remains INSUFFICIENT_ACCESS (not evidence of chronological validation).

Operational_question: Was an untouched out-of-sample test retained after fitting/tuning?
YES_threshold: Final held-out period is identified and distinct from all tuning, selection, threshold choice and early stopping.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Explicit use of same test data for hyperparameter selection or final model choice.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: A test split alone does not establish no test reuse; use AMBIGUOUS when tuning boundary unclear.

Operational_question: Was rolling-origin, expanding-origin, or walk-forward reevaluation performed?
YES_threshold: At least two sequential forecast origins with documented refitting/update and out-of-sample scoring.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Direct statement that the study performed one fixed assessment only, or complete, verifiable implementation and results enumerating only one origin with no sequential reevaluation. Do not infer from one described fold when other experiments may exist.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Rolling input window is NOT evidence of rolling-origin evaluation.

Operational_question: Is the forecast lead defined relative to prediction origin without future label use?
YES_threshold: Explicit forecast-origin and prediction-target timestamps/offset, with labels formed after origin.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Explicit future label/feature entering predictor at prediction origin.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Input lookback length and data frequency are not evidence of prediction horizon.

Operational_question: Was dependence/overlap across temporal partitions addressed?
YES_threshold: Purging, embargo, temporal gap, nonoverlapping test outcomes, or explicit verified prevention of overlapping label leakage.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Explicit overlapping train/test targets despite an identified dependent horizon, without isolation.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: No temporal partition at risk of overlapping labels.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Do not infer lack of protection merely because no embargo is mentioned.

Operational_question: Did multi-asset evaluation avoid asset/time mixing that compromises test independence?
YES_threshold: Documented grouping by asset/time or demonstrably nonoverlapping panel predictions for declared generalization goal.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Explicitly shared overlapping samples across train/test contrary to the evaluation goal.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: Single-series study without multi-asset grouping questions.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Asset generalization and time generalization are different: record scope in evidence notes.

Operational_question: Were data-dependent scaling parameters fitted only to information available in training?
YES_threshold: Scaler fit on training partition/fold and reused unchanged for validation/test (or verified point-in-time rolling fit).
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Global scaler/normalizer fitted across train+future test information.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: No data-dependent scaling or normalization used, explicitly documented.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Technique named alone is not boundary evidence; no leakage from deterministic transformations by default.

Operational_question: Was feature selection performed without access to future evaluation labels?
YES_threshold: Selection/importance rankings fitted inside train/folds only; nested selection documented.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Outcome-informed selection computed globally before partition.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: Feature selection not used, explicitly verified.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Selecting immutable domain features is not automatically fitted feature selection.

Operational_question: Was imputation fitted without test-period information?
YES_threshold: Train-only imputer or causal forward-fill as-of each forecast origin documented.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Future-aware interpolation or global imputer fitted on full series including evaluation observations.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: No missing-value imputation required or used, explicitly documented.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Forward-fill is not necessarily safe if released/revised information is backfilled.

Operational_question: Were data-dependent decompositions causal and training constrained?
YES_threshold: Rolling or fold-limited decomposition, with no test segment included in fitted transform.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Full series decomposed prior to train/test split and outputs used for forecasting.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: No data-dependent decomposition used, explicitly documented.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Presence of EMD/VMD/wavelets alone cannot establish leakage; inspect fitting timeframe.

Operational_question: Were market, accounting and macro inputs available at their stated forecast origin?
YES_threshold: Lag/as-of joins, publication/revision dates or strictly historical data design documented.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Source uses revised/future unavailable inputs at forecast origin.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Market close data cannot automatically be used for a prediction made before market close.

Operational_question: Were texts and sentiment scores point-in-time aligned with the forecast origin?
YES_threshold: Publication timestamp, timezone, market-session cutoff and look-ahead protection described.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Post-outcome texts or sentiment labels were knowingly used to predict earlier prices.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: An annual timestamp or unspecified daily news does not prove alignment.

Operational_question: Were edges, correlations or neighbor sets constructed without future information?
YES_threshold: Past-only adjacency estimation, rolling graph updates or explicit temporal access controls.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Full-period future correlations or surviving constituents used as historically available structure.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: No graph/network or estimated cross-asset structure used.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Graph architecture alone is not evidence of future contamination.

Operational_question: Were parameter, threshold and optimizer choices isolated from final test outcomes?
YES_threshold: Predefined validation/nested tuning objective distinct from final test reported.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Test-period performance explicitly used to select configurations or decision thresholds.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: No model selection or tuning performed, explicitly documented.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Metaheuristic search on validation does not become unbiased just because it is derivative-free.

Operational_question: Does affirmative evidence establish a specific leakage mechanism?
YES_threshold: Exact passage/code shows future aware scaling, lookahead label, test tuning, overlapping split, or equivalent mechanism and explains its direction.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Only for a separately named leakage mechanism, where a passage or complete verified implementation specifically excludes that mechanism. Do not record a global EXPLICIT_NO for PL09; absence of a discovered mechanism is not evidence of universal safety.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: Only when a mechanism is logically irrelevant to method design.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Record one or more controlled mechanism labels (global scaling; full-dataset feature selection; random time split; overlapping outcomes; target look-ahead; textual timing; test-set tuning; future-aware imputation; full-period decomposition; other). Do not infer overall LOW from absence of PL09 YES.

Operational_question: Was the complete relevant fitted preprocessing pipeline trained only on development data?
YES_threshold: Each applicable fitted transform is evidenced as train/fold-only or point-in-time safe.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: At least one fitted transform explicitly uses full future evaluation information.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: No fitted preprocessing is used (explicitly verified).
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Do not upgrade from one train-only scaler to global training-only preprocessing when other fitted transforms are unknown.

Operational_question: What evidence-backed high / low / indeterminate leakage conclusion is defensible?
YES_threshold: Special ordinal judgment, not YES/NO. HIGH requires verified material forward-information contamination affecting a reported evaluation; LOW requires affirmative evidence that all materially applicable temporal, preprocessing, feature timing, and selection/test boundaries are protected in the assessed experiment; INDETERMINATE when evidence insufficient; CONFLICTED when sources disagree.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Not used: this field is a domain judgment rather than a yes/no claim.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: Only if no empirical forecasting or evaluation task.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Document experiment-level evidence and protected/unknown/suspect pipeline boundaries. HIGH if a verified materially leaking experiment contributes to primary claims, with sensitivity for mixed studies. LOW cannot derive from no detected signals. Provide study-level aggregation decision. v1.2: PRIMARY experiment LOW only if all applicable safeguards positively established; retain verified secondary HIGH separately with mixed_experiment_flag; CONFLICTED is for contradictory evidence about the SAME claim. PL11 is ordinal and never enters the Yes/No reporting crosswalk.

Operational_question: Was the evaluated approach compared with at least one implemented benchmark?
YES_threshold: Named comparator with metric on common task/test cohort.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Explicit statement that no baseline was compared.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: Only when the record has no quantitative forecasting performance evaluation to benchmark; an empirical forecasting result without a baseline remains applicable.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Citations to established models do not establish implemented baseline results.

Operational_question: Was a task-appropriate naive comparator included?
YES_threshold: Persistence/random walk for price, majority/no-change for direction, or similarly justified benchmark actually evaluated.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Authors explicitly omit naive benchmark.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Do not equate ARIMA automatically with a random walk benchmark.

Operational_question: Was at least one relevant conventional/current model compared?
YES_threshold: Task-appropriate classical and/or competitive published architecture implemented under comparable protocol.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Authors explicitly state no relevant comparative model was evaluated.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: No evaluated predictive method or forecasting comparison target; an empirical proposed model with no comparator remains applicable.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Whether comparator is strong enough remains a separate critique.

Operational_question: Were comparator data, search budgets and tuning treatment sufficiently matched?
YES_threshold: Common splits/metrics and stated roughly comparable or controlled tuning; differences justified.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Explicit unequal use of test data or mismatched cohorts invalidates stated fair comparison.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Same metrics alone do not establish matched tuning budget.

Operational_question: Were proposed additions evaluated by controlled removal under matched conditions?
YES_threshold: Component-wise leave-one-part-out with common data/split/metric and no obvious confounded architecture change.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Explicit no ablation performed.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Hyperparameter sensitivity is not a component ablation.

Operational_question: Was a formally specified statistical test applied to performance differences?
YES_threshold: Named inferential test with statistic/p-value or decision criteria linked to compared methods.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Authors explicitly state no statistical significance testing.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: No quantitative claim of superiority or comparison among forecasting procedures, conditions or baselines; comparative claims without reported tests remain applicable.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Multiple metric rows or standard deviations alone do not constitute a test. v1.2: full-text-assessed non-reporting is NOT_REPORTED after a documented search, not EXPLICIT_NO. Missing key supplements or insufficient-access abstracts without direct proof are INSUFFICIENT_ACCESS; direct abstract affirmative statements can be YES.

Operational_question: Did uncertainty/test construction account for serial and overlapping forecast dependence?
YES_threshold: Time-block bootstrap, HAC, suitable predictive-loss test with horizon adjustment, or documented dependence-aware procedure.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Explicit iid assumption where source acknowledges overlapping dependent errors without adjustment.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: A t-test or p-value is not automatically valid for dependent errors.

Operational_question: Were multiple tested comparisons or horizon-level hypotheses corrected/controlled?
YES_threshold: Pre-specified family-wise or false discovery adjustment or justified hierarchical test plan.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Authors explicitly report unadjusted multiple testing as final inference without correction.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Do not assume correction because adjusted q-values are absent.

Operational_question: Were quantitative uncertainty intervals reported for predictive performance or effect differences?
YES_threshold: Confidence, posterior or valid bootstrap interval explicitly attached to endpoint or effect estimate.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Explicit statement intervals were not calculated.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Error bars need identified meaning, not automatically confidence intervals.

Operational_question: Was predictive output converted to realized simulated or actual financial decisions?
YES_threshold: Documented trading/allocation strategy with economically interpretable realized performance, not forecast error only.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Authors explicitly state no strategy/backtest was evaluated.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: Only when the study contains no empirical financial predictive evaluation or financial decision analysis. A forecasting paper that reports accuracy but no trading results is applicable, ordinarily NOT_REPORTED unless explicit absence is stated.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: A discussion of possible trading use is not an economic evaluation. v1.2: do not infer an economic experiment from trading-related prose. Assessed full-text non-documentation is distinct from task-level NOT_APPLICABLE. Report the applicable denominator.

Operational_question: Were commissions, fees, spread or explicit transaction costs deducted or modeled?
YES_threshold: At least one quantified execution cost included in strategy calculation.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Source explicitly assumes cost-free trades or omits fees by design.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: No trading or decision backtest performed.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Transaction costs not mentioned does not imply zero costs were actually used. v1.2: an explicit cost-free trading assumption is EXPLICIT_NO; a documented complete full-text search finding no cost accounting is NOT_REPORTED; if there is explicitly no trading or decision backtest, NOT_APPLICABLE.

Operational_question: Were economic outcomes actually reported after applicable costs?
YES_threshold: Return, Sharpe, utility, PnL or other strategy metric explicitly net of quantified trading frictions.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Direct statement or fully specified results showing only gross pre-cost performance or explicit omission of costs; lack of a net metric mention alone is NOT_REPORTED, not proof no net evaluation occurred.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Cost assumed elsewhere does not establish a net reported result.

Operational_question: Are decision rule, threshold, position timing and holding period documented?
YES_threshold: Explicit mapping forecast to position/weight, trade timing, execution horizon and rebalancing.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Authors explicitly state no actionable mapping or use ad hoc ex-post action choices.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Classification accuracy alone is not trade policy.

Operational_question: Are turnover, slippage, spread, liquidity or market impact explicitly assessed?
YES_threshold: Assumed or computed execution feasibility metric beyond abstract predictions, with timing assumptions.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Authors explicitly exclude execution frictions while claiming implementable performance.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Brokerage alone may be insufficient for high-frequency claims.

Operational_question: Are performance figures stratified by regimes or volatility states?
YES_threshold: Separate scores for pre-defined bull/bear, volatility, liquidity or other regime states.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Authors explicitly state no regime-conditioned evaluation was performed.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Mentioning nonstationarity or regime shifts is not evaluated regime robustness.

Operational_question: Are results separately reported for identified externally defined shocks?
YES_threshold: Performance for named pandemic, war, crash, macro shock etc with explicit event window or setting.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Authors explicitly state no event-window test.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Shock context merely mentioned is not a stress test.

Operational_question: Was transfer to new assets, sectors, markets or periods empirically tested?
YES_threshold: Separate held-out transferable setting or explicit external/asset evaluation.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Authors explicitly state single-market single-asset only without transfer.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Multiple assets in one pooled training cohort is not sufficient to prove new-asset generalization.

Operational_question: Were results tested across seeds, splits, parameters, or data perturbations?
YES_threshold: Documented sensitivity protocol with materially distinct reruns and results.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Explicit one-run-only evaluation when claimed; no robustness reruns.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Ablations and sensitivity are different; repeated seeds alone test stochastic robustness only.

Operational_question: Did the study generate a post hoc or intrinsic explanation and report it?
YES_threshold: SHAP, LIME, counterfactual, attribution, concept, or interpretable model analysis actually executed.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Explicit statement no explanations were developed.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: No fitted forecast or model explained.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Attention mechanism by itself does not qualify as validated explanation.

Operational_question: Were explanations checked for faithfulness, stability, or domain plausibility?
YES_threshold: Perturbation/fidelity, stability, counterfactual validity or relevant expert evaluation linked to explanations.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Explicit statement that explanations were not validated.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: No explanation or interpretability method produced.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Attractive feature-importance plots alone do not establish fidelity.

Operational_question: Is predictive uncertainty represented numerically rather than only point forecasts?
YES_threshold: Quantile, interval, distributional prediction or calibrated predictive uncertainty explicitly calculated.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Explicitly deterministic point forecasts without uncertainty estimates.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: No empirical predictive output evaluated. Point-prediction and deterministic models ARE applicable: lack of intervals or distributions cannot be converted into NOT_APPLICABLE.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Dropout or ensemble architecture is not by itself reported uncertainty.

Operational_question: Were forecast probabilities, intervals or uncertainties empirically calibrated?
YES_threshold: Reliability/ECE/Brier for probabilities or coverage/interval score for distributional output.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Explicit statement that calibration/coverage was not assessed.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: No probabilistic or interval predictions reported.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: AUC and classification accuracy are not calibration evidence.

Operational_question: Was study-specific experimental source code publicly accessible in identifiable version?
YES_threshold: Repository/archive accessible at recorded check date and containing identifiable study-specific executable code (or archived runnable script) with source URL, path, version/hash and verification action; capture separate binary flags for LINK_REPORTED and ARTIFACT_VERIFIED.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Authors explicitly state code not released, or repository says unavailable.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: A repository URL alone does not establish working code or reproduce the paper. If once-public code is unavailable now, record access time and source conflict; never invent a commit. v1.2: LINK_REPORTED and ARTIFACT_VERIFIED are distinct recorded outputs. A link that cannot be reached on verification date is not proof of accessible code. Preserve URL, check date, error and source version.

Operational_question: Is experimental data or reconstructible data source available under a defined access route?
YES_threshold: Source is retrievable or individually documented with sufficient dataset identity, sample period and assets to identify intended data; record separately DATA_LINK_ACTIVE and DATA_EXACT_RECONSTRUCTIBLE.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Explicitly unavailable data or license restriction.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: A public dataset named without identifiers/dates is not proof of recoverable study data. Separate public availability from exact experimental reproducibility.

Operational_question: Are architecture, optimizer, training settings and search space sufficiently specified?
YES_threshold: Explicit setting values or reproducible config/code for relevant model and baseline.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Authors explicitly state configurations withheld.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Named Adam or LSTM alone is not enough to reproduce experiments.

Operational_question: Are seed values / random-state controls and repeats documented?
YES_threshold: Concrete seeds, deterministic policy or repeat-run design reported.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Authors explicitly report uncontrolled randomness or no fixed seeds.
NOT_APPLICABLE_rule: Method fully deterministic and no stochastic sampling.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: Repeated-run count without seed reporting is partial evidence; record details.

Operational_question: Are exact train/validation/test dates, cohort identities, or fold manifests recoverable?
YES_threshold: Exact endpoints/identifiers or script creating deterministic partitions with dataset version.
EXPLICIT_NO_threshold: Source states partitions cannot be reconstructed.
Common_ambiguity_and_guardrail: 80/20 proportions alone insufficient to reproduce exact temporal split.
